title: isoloma cordifolium
intro: Isoloma cordifolium, commonly known as Heart-leaved Isoloma, is a medicinal plant species native to tropical Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Isoloma cordifolium include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antidiarrheal, and antispasmodic effects. The plant's leaves are traditionally used to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, and it is also used as an antiseptic and antifungal agent.
